data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2023 were $452.7m. Using the gross claims development table the syndicate recorded a small adverse prior-year development of $3.7m (gross) driven by increased loss estimates for Winter Storm Elliott and Hurricane Ida, partly offset by favourable movements for Hurricane Ian and the 2022 Australian floods and alongside strengthening in 2021 attritional reserves. The report states a $17.2m net increase in prior year reserves after reinsurance. Most impacts relate to property-exposed business.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development gross figure computed from the GROSS claims development table (triangle) which only contains underwriting years 2021-2023; triangle shows an adverse movement of +3.7m (gross) for 2021. The report narrative states a $17.2m net increase in prior year reserves (after reinsurance). The gross movement therefore may differ from reported net movement; no explicit GROSS 'movement in prior year provision' note was found, so the triangle was used as the primary gross source.
